text:
sophia: Quick sync — want to align on the enterprise compliance plan we're shipping in H2. Primary asks: delegated KMS/BYOK, audit log retention tiers, SOC2 evidence exports, and clear launch criteria. Can we list blockers and what we need from each team?

matt: from security side — BYOK wrapper + escrow story needs clarity. Also need per-tenant audit export window (customer-requested 7 years for a few customers). That's above our current default.

diego: engineering constraints — long retention requires storage plan and indexed exports. Current event schema for audit logs is stable but we need an export pipeline and retention TTL config. Question: do we need immutability/writethrough for logs or is signed exports sufficient?

rachel: legal: for some regulated customers, signed auditable exports + chain-of-custody notes are required. 7 years is doable but triggers contract language changes. Need product to define "exportable evidence bundle" format.

sophia: OK — propose we define three retention modes: default (90d), extended (2y), archival (7y) with price tier + ops burden. By default hosted customers get default; extended/archival are enterprise add-ons. Thoughts?

amy: Customer success — several pilot accounts asked for 7y but will accept 2y if we provide reliable export/ingest guidance. They care most about tamper-evident exports and proof-of-delivery.

matt: +1 on tiers. For BYOK: customers want ability to bring keys + rotate keys + evidence of key usage for audits. We'll need KMS audit hooks (who used key, when, for which model). That ties into audit logs.

diego: Implementation notes: we can add per-tenant retention config flag and a background archival job to bucket storage into cold region. Export API can stream a ZIP with md5/sha256 manifest. Example export header: ```{
  "tenant_id": "T123",
  "range_start": "2021-01-01",
  "range_end": "2028-01-01",
  "manifest_sha256": "..."
}``` Would that satisfy legal?

rachel: manifest + sha256 is good. Also include signed statement from our KMS that keys used were customer-managed (BYOK) during the period. That addresses chain-of-custody.

sophia: Launch criteria draft: 1) Per-tenant retention flag in Console + API, 2) Export API with signed manifest, 3) BYOK integration doc + KMS usage audit logs, 4) E2E test with pilot customer, 5) Pricing documented and legal T&Cs updated. Any missing?

amy: Add: runbook for evidence requests (response SLA) and ops page with storage+cost estimates. Customers will ask for SLA on export delivery time.

matt: Add: threat model update and acceptance criteria for tamper-evidence. Also define minimum KMS providers supported for GA (e.g., AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault).

diego: Engineering risk: supporting >3 KMS providers increases integration surface and CI cost. Suggest GA supports AWS + GCP, plan Azure for +1 quarter.

sophia: Proposal: GA scope = retention tiers + export API + BYOK for AWS/GCP + signed manifests + legal T&Cs updated + pilot. Azure added in Q+1. Ops SLA: 5 business days for manual evidence exports, programmatic exports within 24h for small date ranges.

matt: Sounds reasonable. Need security review slot — I'll request it.

security-bot: (automated) Security review requested by matt for thread 1854006789. Review ETA: 5 business days.

rachel: I'll draft the contract language for extended retention and BYOK clauses. Goal: have a legal draft for pilot before next week.

amy: I'll line up two pilot customers (one wants 2y, one asks for 7y) and share acceptance criteria.

sophia: Next steps: diego to own per-tenant retention flag spec, matt to define KMS audit events we need, rachel legal draft, amy pilot signups. We'll reconvene Fri for a short decision. Thanks all :thumbsup:

diego: Will start a spec PR today and tag @matt for KMS event schema.

matt: I'll enumerate required KMS events and sample manifests.

sophia: Thanks — I'll update the product brief and add launch criteria to the roadmap doc.
